The final reference image (Obama) guides ONLY the semi-realistic digital-illustration style, dramatic studio lighting, painterly charismatic orator treatment, composition and visual scale. The earlier reference images identify the selected people in the SPECIFIED quadrants; only those named people must appear in their new specified panels. Preserve their individual likeness without merging identities. CRITICAL: zoom out from corporate headshots. In every panel full hair begins around 16-19% down, chin at 49-53%, head height no more than 35-37% of panel. Show both complete shoulders and chest; generous architectural/party background remains visible high and to the sides, lower corners clear for UI. Vivid, richly lit digital painting matching the original Obama card, not photographic flat studio portraits. ZERO direct camera gazes. Head and pupils turn together naturally 20-25 degrees, never a forced extreme profile, never eyes turned back toward viewer. Vary expressions, poses, backgrounds and professional clothing across people. Background party/institution signage is allowed only as specified, subtle behind the person. TOP LEFT: Jordi Turull. IDENTITY: reference 1, individual image. Preserve the exact face, age, hair and glasses from the specified reference. WARDROBE: smart open-collar shirt/blouse or relaxed blazer/cardigan, appropriate to the individual and documented role. POSE: head AND both eyes naturally RIGHT, 20-25 degrees toward an unseen colleague outside the image; one or two low lectern microphones, a restrained open-hand speaking gesture. BACKGROUND: A varied, richly painted parliamentary/institutional environment with warm burgundy, blue and brass accents. Use reference 3 ONLY for the exact Congreso de los Diputados emblem with its architectural roof and lion, and ONLY the short original wordmark belonging to that emblem. It is an element of the background on a small banner or architectural plaque, never floating UI. Preserve its authentic geometry, icon, colors and integrated lettering; do not replace it with plain typed initials. No other signage or writing: NO long text, NO career description, NO party explanation, NO list of parties, NO invented institution, NO words “GRUPO”, “GROUP”, “PARTIDO” unless literally present in the supplied official emblem. Keep the complete small emblem legible high to one side, with clear space from the face, natural perspective and matching light.
TOP RIGHT: Javier Maroto. IDENTITY: reference 2, individual image. Preserve the exact face, age, hair and glasses from the specified reference. WARDROBE: neat comfortable professional shirt, blouse, knitwear or casual jacket, no mandatory suit/tie, appropriate to the individual and documented role. POSE: head AND both eyes naturally LEFT, 20-25 degrees toward an unseen colleague outside the image; no microphone, attentive thoughtful listening with hands low/out of frame. BACKGROUND: A varied, richly painted parliamentary/institutional environment with warm burgundy, blue and brass accents. Use reference 3 ONLY for the exact Congreso de los Diputados emblem with its architectural roof and lion, and ONLY the short original wordmark belonging to that emblem. It is an element of the background on a small banner or architectural plaque, never floating UI. Preserve its authentic geometry, icon, colors and integrated lettering; do not replace it with plain typed initials. No other signage or writing: NO long text, NO career description, NO party explanation, NO list of parties, NO invented institution, NO words “GRUPO”, “GROUP”, “PARTIDO” unless literally present in the supplied official emblem. Keep the complete small emblem legible high to one side, with clear space from the face, natural perspective and matching light.
Unassigned remaining panel: an empty softly lit parliamentary interior, no extra person, no text label.
BRAND ACCURACY OVERRIDES ALL PRIOR SIGNAGE SUGGESTIONS. Show ONLY the exact supplied authentic emblem required for each specified panel. No explanatory text, fake seals, or acronyms substituting its icon. The final Obama reference is still style-only. Never transfer a party/institution mark to a different panel. Faces, eyes and heads must remain naturally off-camera. Every panel that uses a brand reference must show its COMPLETE emblem, including all its integrated icon AND lettering TOGETHER, never splitting it between panels. Put a small complete lockup in the top 12% or to the side, fully visible and away from the face, with original proportions. No extra typography.
